description: Solana token risk scan: rug pull, scam token and token safety check. Use when buying, accepting or listing a token. Input: mint. Output: JSON riskLevel + signals w/ evidence: mint authority, freeze authority (can freeze/blacklist holders), permanent delegate, transfer hook/fee, default-frozen, mutable metadata, top-10 holder share. No sell simulation; not an audit. Example: ?mint=EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v Price: $0.009 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

mint.description: Token mint address on Solana mainnet (base58, 32 bytes). Bad input → 400, not a mint → 422 (not charged)
